summary: Auralytics: compressed-response truncation + token-count billing mismatch and PII redaction misses during peak window
description:
Issue summary:
During a high-throughput window (09:40–10:20 UTC) Auralytics reported that streaming responses to chat requests were truncated mid-token and the token accounting used for billing did not match customer-visible token counts. Additionally, several customer-provided transcripts that should have been redacted for PII showed missed redaction markers.

Impact:
- Production traffic for Auralytics (enterprise plan) experienced truncated completions causing downstream application errors and user-visible missing sentences.
- Billing delta: Auralytics observed a 28% discrepancy between counted tokens on the platform and tokens they were charged for (platform over-count).
- PII redaction failures: three production transcripts (sample IDs included below) returned unhashed email addresses in 7/324 requests inspected.

Environment:
- prod | us-east (primary cluster serving Auralytics dedicated tenant pool)
- Model variants: rw-large-v2 (primary); fallback to rw-compact-quant during autoscale bursts

Steps to reproduce (customer provided):
1) Send a 3-turn chat with a ~1200 token context and request streaming=true and compress_responses=true.
2) Observe that stream terminates with HTTP/2 200 but final chunk ends mid-codepoint and the client-side token count is lower than billing API report.
3) Re-run with PII-redaction header set; inspect transcript for expected redaction markers.

Logs / Evidence:
- Customer attachments: three sample transcripts (auralytics-samp-1.txt, -2.txt, -3.txt).
- Platform logs (traces): request-ids: req_20260311_us_east_9: 0f3a2d, 0f3a2e, 0f3a2f.
- Billing export: invoice_snapshot_2026-03-11_Auralytics.csv (shows token counts by request id).
- Streaming proxy trace: stream_conn_45678 shows FIN after partial frame, no 5xx returned.
impact: User-facing truncation for Auralytics resulting in degraded UX; potential overbilling exposure and PII safety lapse (missed redactions). Customer has escalated to legal and SRE; contract SLA at risk.
steps_to_reproduce: Send 3-turn chat ~1200 token context with streaming=true and compress_responses=true
Observe final stream chunk ends mid-token while HTTP/2 connection returns 200
Compare platform billing token count to client tokenization and check redaction headers
logs: req_20260311_us_east_9_0f3a2d: serving-runtime: chunked write closed unexpectedly at seq 37
streaming-proxy: conn 45678 FIN after frame 42; no 5xx returned
investigation_notes: Hypothesis A: compress_responses pipeline introduced a truncation bug when switching kernel/quantized fallback during a burst; edge case in frame assembly produced a short final frame.

Hypothesis B: billing counter listens to post-assembly token accounting and double-counts overlapping prefix cache snapshots during streaming replay; mismatch arises when prefix/KV cache is applied and then reassembled for billing export.

Redaction impact likely orthogonal: redaction-service appears to run as an async post-processor for streaming outputs in the prod routing for enterprise tenants; observed race where truncated output is persisted before redaction completes.
Observed correlation: spikes in autoscaler activity at 09:41 UTC concurrent with high transient pool swap (rw-large-v2 -> rw-compact-quant).
actions_taken: Escalated to Serving Runtime on-call (ticket routed to #sre and #incidents).
Disabled compress_responses for Auralytics tenant as immediate mitigation at 10:05 UTC (stop-gap to prevent further truncation).
Initiated a billing interim credit hold while audit runs; finance notified and invoice paused for the affected window.
Triggered synchronous redaction for the three sampled transcripts and quarantined the originals; customer notified and legal looped in.
Canary rollout of fix-PR 2367 halted after reproducing truncation in staging during high-concurrency tests.
resolution: Work in progress. Temporary mitigations: compress_responses disabled for the customer and billing for window 09:30–10:30 UTC placed on audit hold. Root cause triage points to a frame-assembly bug in compress_responses + quantized-fallback path; fix PR (serving-runtime#2367) created but requires additional assertions around streaming frame boundaries and synchronous redaction gating. Next steps: complete PR with added unit/integration tests, run full replay audit to compute billing credits, and run an executive customer update by EOD 2026-03-13.
postmortem_plan: Complete fix-PR with frame-boundary assertions and merge after canary on staging (target 2026-03-14)
Full billing replay audit and credit calculation (Finance + Billing team) - target complete 2026-03-15
Add end-to-end test for redaction gating to ensure persisted outputs are only written after redaction completed
Update runbook: mark compress_responses + quantized-fallback as risky combination and add automatic disable policy when autoscaler triggers model swap
